title: How Picking Up the Tab Without Being Asked Builds the Man Who Leads First
caption:
Christ didn't lead by title. He led by taking the worse seat, the harder task, the towel nobody else would pick up.

Kingdom leadership runs backward from the world's version: the cost comes before the credit, not after it. Reaching for the check before anyone asks is a small, cheap, repeatable way to train that reflex.

The man who pays for what nobody asked him to pay for is the same man who volunteers for the hard conversation later. Same rep, different room.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
